page.layout: One page of text in two sections: running head at top; heading and verse epitaph for Enricus Molleri, then a second heading and verse epitaph for Petri Lamonii below a rule. No margin notes. Page number at top right.

main_text.head: ENRICI MOLLERI THEOlogiæ quondam in Academia VVitebergensi doctoris, Professoris, Memoriæ.

p.i: Rnabas patriam nuper, Mollere, superstes, Exulis ingratam qua probat interitus. Am quo delirans pepulit te patria, tecum Hoc ipso Pietas pulsa furore fuit. Errena e patria cuius miserata fugatam Mox animam Vera restituit patria. Cuñias Vero, turba affectante piorum, Hoc manibus tumulo condidit ipsa suis. Irce tuis, Mollere, nocens te patria iuvit, Teque e solo pellens, addidit ecce polo.

main_text.head: PETRI LAMONII, CAROLI Parisiensis Senatoris F. ingenio ab ipsa pueritia insignis, doctrina supra captum adolescentiæ, ipsis exteris Italis admirabilis, Memoriæ.

p.i: Amonij exuuia extincti florente iuventa, Viator, hic sunt condita: ue, truculenta licet, fleuit miserata cadentem. His ipsa Parca sociis, [illegible, ~6 letters] nomen (ait) iuuenili in corpore cana Tua me fefellit indoles,

page.notes: The scan is faint and cut at the left edge; the first verse lines of both epitaphs are partly damaged and several words in them are doubtful. Heading text partly garbled on the left margin. Printed verse is transcribed as far as legible.
